package.name: sam_perception
package.description: Perception sensor bringup for SAM 2.2: WaterLinked Sonar 3D-15 + Intel RealSense D435i. In simulation the topics come from Unity (sam2.2 prefab) over the ros_tcp bridge and this package runs a rate monitor; on hardware it launches the actual drivers remapped into the same topic names, so downstream consumers are identical in sim and reality.
